correctness.rationale: For pair lists that are matchings, the union graph has maximum degree two, including shared-pair parallel edges. One enumerates every recipient assignment by a transfer DP carrying the two own utilities, two cross valuations, and two boundary colours. Induction over vertices proves full signature coverage. Since deleting a good destroys at most one complete valued pair, EF1 is equivalent to cross evaluations at most own utility plus one. Pareto optimality is exactly the nondominated own-utility frontier. Cycle proofs use the uniqueness of the two alternating perfect matchings, a balancing contiguous split, and a componentwise frontier argument. Exact implementation was compared with independent complete enumeration on 1,700 random instances and 8 single-cycle cases.

value.rationale: The source proves incompatibility of EF1 and PO and general SPOC welfare hardness, motivating exact islands of tractability. The two-agent, pair-size-two, additive-free-matroid subclass has an interpretable interaction graph (paths/cycles), and the claim supplies exact efficient fair allocation feasibility, witnesses and optimal fair welfare, plus a sharp 4-good versus >=6-good connected transition and an 8-good disconnected obstruction. It is not a mere relabeling or a single tiny recomputation; it resolves all inputs in a natural subdomain.
